primary_math_proof: Let positive rectangle widths be a,b,c,d with a+b+c+d=36. Original line one runs from centre(a) to centre(b): length a/2+b/2. Line two is c/2+d/2. Sum is18 regardless of four lengths, uniquely A. No coordinates of this particular illustrative partition are treated as givens. False full-to-half transfer gives a/2+b+c/2+d=18+(b+d)/2, which varies with widths and would support E. E is an anticipated mistaken dependence claim, not the actual geometry.
